summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` bundled in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727 KB file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a rotated string-array obfuscation pattern (randomized identifiers, a shuffled `n7gIxM` array with a rotator function) that is not evaluable by Node-based tooling. The advertised purpose of the package is a tslint folder-schema rule (lib/folderSchemaRule.js); none of the declared dependencies (commander, folder-lint, lodash, tslint) require Bun or a compiled bundle, and the tslint rule code has no relationship to the preinstall behavior. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape — fetch an interpreter, then execute an opaque bundled payload under it — evades scanners that inspect only Node-resolvable code, and executes on every `npm install` before any user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
